buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Bid-Specific Additional Terms and Conditions for Desktop & Laptop 1. Bid-Specific OEM Authorization Certificate (MAF): Must be provided with the bid. 1. Ink-signed and stamp ed by OEM with bid number and date clearly mentioned. 2. Uniform OEM Branding: CPU, Monitor, Wired Keyboard, and Mouse must be from the same OEM. All com ponents should bear the same OEM logo 3. Comprehensive Warranty: PCs must carry a 3-year comprehensive on-site warranty from date of installation and commissioning. Bidder should submit declaration of 3-year onsite warranty on OEM letter head with sign, seal, bid number and date clearly mentioned 4. Malicious Code Certificate: OEM must provide a certificate stating the absence of malicious code. Should be on OEM letterhead, with bid number, date, signature, and seal. 5. Product Compliance Sheet: Must be submitted on OEM letterhead and it should include bid number, dat e, sign, and seal. 6. Product Data Sheets: Detailed data sheets of offered products must be uploaded with the bid with prope r marking and signing. Technical parameters must match the offered configuration. Any mismatch may res ult in bid rejection.

7. OEM Operations in India: OEM must have been operational in India for at least 15 years. Documentary p roof must be submitted. OEM should have submit factory address with documentary proof. 8. Service Escalation Matrix: Must be submitted on OEM letterhead with bid number, date, sign, and seal. 9. Compliance Check Statement: Required on OEM letterhead with bid number, date, sign, and seal. 10. Bidder’s Local Service Center in West Bengal Region: Bidder must have a service center in the WB region. Proof like electricity bill, municipal tax receipt, etc., must be provided. 11. Requiring an OEM Authorized Service Centre in the consignee District: Documentary evidence ( Trade li cense, GST ) must be submitted; otherwise, bid will be rejected. 12. Bidder Non-Blacklisting Declaration Bidder should be on the non-judicial stamp paper. 13. OEM Market Standing: OEM must be listed among the top three companies in IDC Report (India Overall PC Market) for the last three consecutive quarters based on Market Share, Year over-Year Growth 14. OEM Turnover: OEM’s turnover should be more than ₹10,000 Crore for FY 2023-24. Proof must be sub mitted. 15. Bidder Turnover: Bidder should have a minimum turnover of Ten (10) Crore for FY 2023-24 a. Bidder m ust submit Acknowledgement copy of GST for the period. Supporting documents to be provided. 16. Mandatory Document Submission: Bidder’s offer is liable to be rejected if any required certificates/doc uments from the bid, ATC, or corrigendum are missing. 17. BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 18. Offered product or OEM with Windows, RoHS, EPEAT, ENERGY STAR- 8.0, EHS or higher, ISO 27001. 45 001, 50001 Certificate relating to relevant product will be preferred. 19. Bidder must have to be Submit Last 3 Financial Year IT Returns copy, Annual Turnover Certificate with Proper UDIN No. and Audit Reports along with Balance Sheet signed by Chattered accountant with UDIN i.e . (2022-23, 2023-24,24-25). 20. The OEM of Desktop should be ISO 9001; ISO 14001; ISO 45001, ISO 50001 Certified. ATC clauses for Printer 1. The OEM of Printer should be ISO 9001; ISO 14001; ISO 27001 Certified. 2. OEM of Printer should have their own service center minimum 4 nos. to cater for after sales service(pref erably in Assam) Documentary evidence in this regard with proof of existence of service center like rent a greement, electricity bill etc. to be submitted alongwith the bid. 4. OEM of Printer should have been in India operations for past minimum 10 years. Documentary evidenc e of such existence in the form of certificate of incorporation and end user purchase order copies to be sub mitted in the bid. 5. OEM of Printer should have been in profit for past 5 years. Documentary evidence in this regard to sub mitted alongwith the bid.

7. OEM of Printershould undertake that the quoted products are with OEM warranty as per bid requirement and not of bidder. Undertaking for providing URL for verification of the warranty in the OEM website to be p rovided alongwith the bid. 9. The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be ban krupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 10. Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buye rs will match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. Such offered specifications has to outline the offered parameters. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bi d is liable for rejection. OEM Technical compliance statement of the offered products alongwith public url o f the quoted products to be submitted in the bid. 11. Bidders shall quote only those products in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 5 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of-life by the OEM before this period. Undertaking on the same to be part of the bid. 12. Bidder should not be blacklisted/debarred by any Ministry under Government of India or by Governme nt of any State in India or any of the Government PSUs in the last Five years. Certificate / affidavit mention ing that the Bidder is not blacklisted by any Ministry under Government of India or by Government of any S tate in India or any of the Government PSUs to be submitted in the bid. 13. All undertakings/declarations to be signed by a person in OEM with details . 15. Printer should have following certificates CE, UL , ROHS , EHS and BIS .
